mechanics.claim: Carnivore triggers whenever Cho'Gath kills an enemy, healing and restoring mana.
mechanics.quote: Whenever '''Cho'Gath''' kills an enemy, it {{tip|heals}} for {{pplevel|18 to 52|color=heal}} and restores {{as|{{sti|mana|{{pplevel|4.72 to 9.48}} mana}}}}.

mechanics.claim: Carnivore also triggers on destroying a turret, but not other structures.
mechanics.quote: ''Carnivore'' will also trigger when '''Cho'Gath''' destroys a {{tip|turret}}, but not from other structures.

mechanics.claim: Carnivore does not trigger on killing wards.
mechanics.quote: ''Carnivore'' does not trigger upon destroying {{tip|wards}} and possibly other similar units.
